intermediate_failure_causes: The web/workflow suite that recomputes the catalog needs fastapi, which is not installed in the base environment; the first run failed at collection until the recorded verified dependency directory was supplied as PYTHONPATH, after which all 18 checks pass.
coverage_gate: require_complete raises instead of claiming completeness
complete scope only at exactly 100% coverage
scope_limit: Public field definitions now have a registry and a completeness gate instead of a prose promise. Each registered column carries one checkable sentence plus its value kind, unit or scale, producing stage, status and a schema-verified flag; component-specific clarifications override the shared semantics where the same column name means something else in another module. The published catalog now attaches the definition to every field, reports defined/total coverage with the exact undefined column list, and may only declare the complete scope when coverage is exactly 100%: otherwise it keeps the incomplete scope and reports the gap. Pending entries never count, an empty catalog is refused, and the web/workflow suite that recomputes the catalog continues to pass, including its tampered-scope rejection. This is progress, not closure: the registry defines 35 columns and 5 component clarifications, no archived published catalog was located within the read-only search window, and full coverage of the actual published columns still requires an actual publication inventory. No definition asserts a scientific finding, no optimizer, real cohort, paid compute or deployment ran, and no requirement was promoted.
